settings.bbox_coordinate_space: original image pixel xyxy; clamped to image dimensions
settings.clip_image_preprocessing: project pipeline/clip_embedder.py preprocess, RGB crop, L2-normalized image embedding
settings.clip_text_normalization: L2-normalize each text embedding; prompt ensemble is mean then L2-normalized

methodology_notes: Frame-level multilabel presence scoring; a frame can contain both cat and dog.
LOOV selects padding/prompt/margin on three videos and evaluates on the fourth; only four video groups, so uncertainty remains high.
Candidate bbox availability is a proxy for detection/localization; no ground-truth boxes were annotated, so IoU localization quality was not measured.
Full-sample best settings were selected and scored on the same reviewed labels and are optimistic; use LOOV as the less biased estimate.
